name: Compressed attention (CSA + HCA)
change: Every layer keeps a short sliding window of one shared K=V vector per token. Compressed sparse attention (CSA) layers also pool every 4 tokens into one compressed entry and pick among them with a lightning indexer; heavily compressed attention (HCA) layers pool every 128 tokens into one entry and attend to all of them.
problem_solved: Even a latent cache grows linearly with context. Compressing old tokens into pooled entries cuts the cache at 1M tokens to about a tenth of DeepSeek-V3.2's.
trade_off: Distant tokens are only visible through pooled entries, so exact recall of a far token depends on the compressor and the indexer; the engine keeps small buffers of tokens waiting to fill a window.
kv_formula: L × min(T, W−1) × d × b + Σ_CSA ⌊T/4⌋ × (d + d_index) × b + Σ_HCA ⌊T/128⌋ × d × b

reference.title: DeepSeek-V4: Towards Highly Efficient Million-Token Context Intelligence
